idea.title: SlideCards for my course
idea.text: A web app that turns a student's own lecture slides into spaced-repetition flashcards, for university students.

evidence.quote: Ask HN: why is making flashcards from slides still manual?. Exporting slides into flashcards loses diagrams.
Feature request: import lecture PDF directly. There is no direct PDF import, so cards are retyped.
Turns lecture slides into spaced-repetition flashcards. Making flashcards by hand takes hours.

idea.title: Flaky test tracker
idea.text: A small service that reads CI history and lists flaky tests for small teams.

evidence.quote: Ask HN: how do small teams track flaky tests?. Flaky tests are re-run by hand and forgotten.
Detects flaky tests from CI history. Flaky tests waste CI minutes and trust.

idea.title: Student budget forecaster

idea.title: Forgiving study planner
idea.text: A study planner that reschedules revision automatically when a student misses a day.

evidence.quote: Ask HN: a study planner that reacts to missed days?. Planners break as soon as one day is missed.
Study planner that spreads revision before exams. Students cram because planning is manual.
